issuer: Electricity Distribution Company Ltd. (EDCL), Revenue & Metering Cell, Noida
summary: Your electricity meter showed an overload warning because your power usage is higher than allowed. You must apply to increase your sanctioned power limit within 15 days.

actions.task: Submit load regularization form and Rs. 1,500 inspection fee

deadline.quote: within 15 days of the issue of this notice

actions.why_it_matters: Prevent electric power disconnection under Electricity Supply Code Regulation 4.2

documents_needed: Copy of ownership proof / lease deed of premises
if_ignored: Power supply will be disconnected without further intimation.
